verdict.rationale: An agent framework could plausibly ship scheduling or cron-style triggers, so this axis applies to the OpenAI Agents SDK. The evidence pack covers only on-demand execution via Runner.run/run_sync/run_streamed, plus sessions, tracing and human-in-the-loop resume, with no built-in scheduling or recurring-job capability. The community mention of a Temporal-based durable version describes durable workflows, not scheduling, so it does not establish this capability.
